thread:
Priya: quick heads-up 3 onboarding for model "pelican-lite" (3.8B) finished. saw an odd tail-recall degradation after int8_per_channel quantization concentrated around long-tail queries.
Priya: top-level numbers (holdout-longtail, n=15k):
Priya:  - baseline fp16 r@1: 0.885
Priya:  - pelican-lite fp16 r@1: 0.883
Priya:  - pelican-lite int8-per-channel r@1: 0.861
Priya:  - r@50 delta (int8-per-channel): -2.5% (relative drop in long-tail neighborhood overlap)
Priya:  - silhouette: fp16 0.47 -> int8 0.39
Priya: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/3791234567/ (metrics-bot uploaded)
Marco: can you paste eval command + seed + tokenizer + index type?
Priya: ran:
Priya: ```
Priya: python eval_embeddings.py --model pelican-lite --quant int8_per_channel --holdout holdout-longtail --seed 77 --normalize true --knn faiss-brute --batch-dist zipf:1-128
Priya: ```
Chiara: long-tail sensitivity often indicates calibration mismatch or coordinate clipping on rare tokens. did you use full-corpus calibration?
Priya: yes default-calib-20k (corpus mix). Jun provided a long-tail sample earlier, not included in default.
Eve: two quick checks: (1) per-query neighbor-margin distribution (nn1 - nn2) for failed queries, (2) coordinate-wise variance shift for bottom 10% freq tokens.
Priya: margin stats show failed queries median margin 0.011 vs overall median 0.058. coord-variance dump attached in artifacts.
Jun: i can push a 10k long-tail calibration slice from logs if helpful.
Priya: please do, Jun. I'll run three ablations: A) per-tensor int8, B) per-channel with long-tail calibration, C) post-quant mean-rescale + L2 re-center.
metrics-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/3791234567/ (eval.json, recall_curve_k1-200.csv, nn_margin.tsv)
Marco: also try exact brute-force knn on a 2k sample to rule out index amplification. if brute-force still shows r@50 drop it's numeric not index.
Priya: queued ablations (jobs 3791234568..70). running brute-force sample too. ETA ~90m. will attach failing-queries.csv if reproduces.
Chiara: add a small analysis: compute per-dim kurtosis change post-quant. long-tail tokens may concentrate on high-kurtosis dims and get clipped by per-channel scales.
Eve: simulate tiny gaussian noise on fp16 to see if rank-swap pattern resembles int8. also try increasing K in recall to 200 to inspect tail more.
Priya: quick interim 3 per-tensor run improved r@50 by ~1.3% (half the gap). per-channel with long-tail calibration recovered ~1.9% and lowered silhouette drop. post-quant mean-rescale regained nearly full parity (r@50 delta -0.2%).
Priya: looks like calibration mix + mean-shift are the main drivers, index only amplifies. saving failing-query snapshots to ENGML-9124.
Marco: nice triage. action items:
Marco:  - Priya: attach failing queries + notebook showing mean-rescale ablation to ENGML-9124 (owner: Priya)
Marco:  - Chiara: inspect converter calibrator heuristics and add option to inject long-tail slice when present (owner: Chiara)
Marco:  - Jun: add a small long-tail sampler to on-board smoke that runs when holdout-longtail is used (owner: Jun)
Marco:  - Eve: add gaussian-perturb unit test to catch rank-swap patterns (owner: Eve)
Priya: created ENGML-9124 and uploaded the notebook and sample lists. linking artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/3791234568/
metrics-bot: rerun artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/3791234568/ (ablation results, notebook, failing_queries.csv)
Eve: thumbs up. if mean-rescale fixes most cases we should add an optional post-quant l2 re-center step to the converter pipeline behind a flag.
Chiara: agreed. i'll prototype a safe default that only re-centers when mean shift > 3% on the holdout.
Priya: will add a short note in the embed runbook about long-tail calibration sensitivity and link ENGML-9124. thanks all :thumbsup:
